name: save-to-taste
description: Save to taste: a Firefox extension that saves right-clicked images and videos to your own taste server.

scripts.lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml README.md 'icons/*.svg' node_modules
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml README.md 'icons/*.svg' node_modules dist
scripts.start: web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml README.md node_modules dist
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --ignore-files package.json pnpm-lock.yaml README.md 'icons/*.svg' node_modules dist
